# FinanceYourGear.com

> > FinanceYourGear.com connects consumers with personal loan offers for recreational vehicles, outdoor equipment, home improvements, and consumer goods—even with bad credit.

The platform specializes in bad credit financing for powersports (Polaris, Honda, Kawasaki), boats (bass boats, pontoons, Jon boats), backyard gear (Traeger grills, Big Green Egg), fitness equipment (Concept 2 rowing machines), electronics (Apple Watch, DSLR cameras), furniture sets, and business equipment. FYG serves as a loan marketplace helping cash buyers finance purchases across diverse categories.
